component_scope: H1 typed claude_code_peer capability/request/result/backflow integration; not live Claude transport and not H1 package PASS
semantic_findings: Claude capability visibility is dynamic state, not a permanent prompt fact.
Claude and local FRANK retain separate instance identity; only typed semantic deltas enter the local ledger.
Peer opinion remains proposal/evidence; only scoped VERIFIED execution receipts establish the exact local effect they name.
Peer conflict enters CONFLICT semantics and does not overwrite the local CURRENT semantic claim.
Raw peer prose is hash-addressed but not mirrored into the bounded 4B Assembly; compact backflow carries a detail reference.
A committed peer delta was demonstrated to influence a later GWT competition/selection/uptake/causal-use path in the same unified ledger.
Duplicate result idempotency is explicit: semantically duplicate accepted result fingerprints return DUPLICATE_IGNORED.

The conservative H1 baseline rejects a result when the shared basis epoch advances while the request is in flight; future research may distinguish read-only evidence acceptance from consequential writeback revalidation.

negative_results.finding: First GitHub create of integrated peer test returned HTTP 409 because repository head advanced concurrently.
negative_results.resolution: re-read target path, confirmed absent, retried against current head; create succeeded; no blind overwrite.

limitations: Claude results are deterministic fixtures, not a live Claude Code transport invocation.
Current project capacity says Claude research is temporarily unavailable in a separate lane; no live peer receipt is claimed.
